messages:
alex: @maya @jordan @sam @linda Heads up — need to schedule a design review for the new Batch API + Console UX (SDK impact too). Looking for a 60m slot next week to cover API surface, clients, canary plan, and perf targets. Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/docs/batch-api-design (please add comments)

maya: +1. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings. Is 60m needed? can we timebox 45?

jordan: I can do Wed morning, need 15–20 to walk through console mockups and nav changes.

sam: SDK changes will be minor. 30m async walkthrough could work if API surface is stable. Can we add compatibility notes?

alex: Draft agenda (timeboxed):
``` 
1) 5m intro & goals
2) 15m API surface & backward compat
3) 15m Console UX flows + mockups
4) 10m SDK impact & migration path
5) 10m Canary/rollout plan + Qs
``` 
Should we do 45 or 60?

linda: FYI I'll need to sign off on auth/KMS usage. Send pre-read 24h before pls.

alex: Proposed slots: 
- Tue 9:30–10:30 PT
- Wed 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 1:00–2:00 PT
React with :one: :two: :three: or suggest another time. RSVP by EOD Friday.

maya: :two: works for me

jordan: :two: +1

sam: :one: or :two:, leaning :two:

dev-bot: Reminder set — pre-read link pinned to #eng and calendar invite will include the checklist.

alex: Great — tentatively booking Wed 10:00–11:00 PT. I'll post the pre-read checklist in thread. Please add any doc comments by Tue EOD.

alex: Pre-read checklist:
```
- Design doc linked
- Open API spec (yaml)
- Console mockups (Figma link)
- Performance targets & current numbers
- Canary plan & fallback
- Migration notes for SDK
- Security sign-off owner
```

jordan: Added a Figma comment on slide 3.

linda: Will try to review pre-read by Tue evening.

alex: Thanks — calendar invite incoming. If you can't make it, DM me and we can record.
